sourceNotes: 出口与分流窗口新增 WebRTC 与 DNS 检测
WebRTC 检测结果补充公网 IP 的国家、城市和网络归属信息
AI 入口移至工具分组
订阅账号支持设置首选账号，菜单栏和小组件统一使用
额度小组件支持小尺寸两行与中尺寸单行布局，补充服务图标、相对重置时间和单圈／双圈样式设置
完善 Magpie 未安装或未连接时的引导，默认刷新与失败重试间隔调整为 5 分钟
出口检测结果在关窗后保留，统一手动检测与完成时间，并按当前分类内容适配窗口缩放
AI 统计仅通过 Magpie 本地接口读取，移除独立日志扫描、直连额度与价格查询

en: Add WebRTC and DNS tests to the egress and routing window to compare HTTP egress, public candidate addresses and DNS resolvers.
Show country, city and network information for public IP addresses in WebRTC results.
Move AI to Tools and add Token, cost, request and generation-speed trends. Fix clicks in the empty area of period buttons.

Choose a preferred subscription account shared by the menu bar and widgets. Show selection controls only for services with multiple accounts and return to Magpie order when a selected account is deleted.
Add two-row small and single-row medium quota widgets, service icons, relative reset times and single- or double-ring settings.
Improve setup guidance when Magpie is missing or disconnected and set refresh and failure retry intervals to five minutes by default.
Keep egress results after closing the window, unify manual testing and completion times, and fit window zoom to the current category.
Read AI statistics exclusively from the local Magpie API. Remove independent log scanning, direct quota access and price lookups; install and run Magpie to use AI statistics.
